name: How long does it take to complete a drought-tolerant landscape project?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a drought-tolerant landscape project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a drought-tolerant landscape project depends on its scope and complexity. A small-scale renovation might take 2-4 weeks from design to completion. Larger, more intricate projects involving significant hardscaping, grading, or extensive planting can range from 6-12 weeks or more. We establish clear timelines during the planning phase, taking into account material availability and weather conditions, to keep you informed every step of the way.
